class.name: Box3DSurfaceMaterial
class.description: [Box3DSurfaceMaterial] defines physics response and game metadata for one named surface. [member material_id] is written to Box3D as [code]userMaterialId[/code].

members.member:
Project-defined gameplay data for this surface, such as footstep sounds, impact decals or penetration settings. Declare a script class extending [Box3DSurfaceGameplayData] and select it in [b]Project Settings > Physics > Gameplay Data Class[/b]. New materials are then created with an instance of it already assigned, and this slot is limited to that class: [codeblock] # res://surface_gameplay_data.gd class_name SurfaceGameplayData extends Box3DSurfaceGameplayData
@export_range(0.0, 1.0) var penetration := 0.0 @export var footsteps: AudioStreamRandomizer [/codeblock] [codeblock] var surface := Box3DPhysics.get_material(hit_material_id) var data := surface.gameplay as SurfaceGameplayData if data: play_footstep(data.footsteps) [/codeblock]
Permanent material slot id in the range [code]1[/code] through [code]15[/code]. [code]0[/code] is reserved for the default material. The library derives this value from the slot position.
Stable material name used by authoring tools and scripts. An empty name marks an unconfigured slot, which is omitted from queries and pickers.
Box3D tangent velocity for conveyor-style surfaces.
Case-insensitive wildcard patterns used by import tools to match texture names.
